tweet.text:
$KOSPI is finally showing signs of improvement.

Down ~40% from the June 22 peak.

RSI back at oversold.
Forward P/E at 5x, forward P/FCF at 5x.

Oversold and cheap aren't a bottom signal on their own, but you can't get a recovery without them.

Worth remembering what got repriced. The KOSPI's leading names make the memory the AI buildout runs on. And they're now largely deleveraged.

A 40% drawdown in five weeks didn't change their place in the stack. What it showed is that even the best fundamentals can get crowded, leveraged and overbought. We all know what comes next.

I'm still 100% long, but I'm taking lessons from this. The most obvious one is Korea's importance to the AI buildout.

Everyone listens when the Fed is about to announce a rate decision. Maybe we should listen just as closely to the health of the countries physically building this thing.
